scenarios.name: Escalated Global Conflict
scenarios.description: Escalation of tensions in the Middle East or Eastern Europe leading to energy price shocks and supply chain disruptions

impacts.explanation: Increased energy costs and supply chain bottlenecks drive up consumer prices
Defense spending increases and economic slowdown require fiscal stimulus

scenarios.reasoning: High probability due to ongoing regional tensions and historical patterns of conflict escalation
tetlockCommandments: Break seemingly intractable problems into tractable sub-problems

scenarios.name: Tech Decoupling Accelerates
scenarios.description: US-China tech separation intensifies, affecting global supply chains and manufacturing costs

impacts.explanation: Higher input costs and reduced export demand from China
Weaker consumer confidence in durable goods

scenarios.reasoning: Strong possibility given US export controls and China's countermeasures
tetlockCommandments: Strike the right balance between under- and overreacting to evidence

scenarios.name: Fiscal Stimulus Package
scenarios.description: Congressional passage of significant infrastructure and tax relief measures

impacts.explanation: Direct investment in infrastructure and consumer spending boost

scenarios.reasoning: Moderate probability based on political dynamics and economic need
tetlockCommandments: Look for the errors behind your errors

scenarios.name: Trade Policy Shifts
scenarios.description: New US trade agreements or tariffs significantly alter global commerce patterns

impacts.explanation: Reduced exports from new tariffs or retaliatory measures
Higher import costs pressure central bank to tighten

scenarios.reasoning: Lower probability but increasing likelihood with election cycles
tetlockCommandments: Strike the right balance between under- and overconfidence

scenarios.name: Monetary Policy Tightening

impacts.explanation: Reduced business investment leads to job cuts

scenarios.reasoning: Balanced probability considering persistent inflation and rate sensitivity

scenarios.reasoning: Represents base case with historical context of mixed indicators
